additional_info.subject: RE: ID0426768-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP/R4170001744] Charger Offline CRM:02888000015
additional_info.body:
Dear Mura Florian,
We have observed that the charger is currently online on both SCB and OCPP systems, with no active error flags. Additionally, we have recorded a successful charging session, which further confirms that the unit is functioning as expected.
Specifically, we noticed an ongoing charging session from
2025-05-27, 10:56:47 UTC to 2025-05-27, 11:11:26 UTC
, associated with
transactionId: 50058792.
Furthermore, with the assistance of our expert colleagues, we remotely accessed the charger and were able to view the screen without any issues. Please find below the pictures for your reference.
Kindly let us know if you are still experiencing any issues with the screen, so we can take further action accordingly.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Vikas Khiladkar
